purpose: Teach: チェルシー/太宰/アンパン/紀伊国屋/バロック/リアリズム/ホビー/マイカー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがチェルシーの試合中継を観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was watching the Chelsea match on TV.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Gentle lift on 'Sho.' Pace steady and unhurried. Voice carries the quiet knowledge of what he's been doing without judgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと太宰治のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me a story about Dazai!
lines.style: Quick bright opening. Genuine excitement without shrillness. Eager to share, looking up at her. Small pause before the exclamation point — checking her face to see if she's listening.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアンパンマンの絵本を選んで下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad chose an Anpanman picture book for you.
lines.style: Knowing, gentle. Voice carries a small warmth on 'chose' — noticing the care in that choice. Slow, deliberate. Ends softly, like she's reflecting on what it means.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと紀伊国屋書店に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to Kinokuniya bookstore!
lines.style: Bright, eager. The exclamation bubbles up naturally. Slightly faster than before. Wants her to understand how special the outing was — he wanted books, real ones.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバロック音楽の演奏会に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad went to a Baroque music concert.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful. Voice settles on the 'Baroque' with slight wonder. Slow pace. Not explaining — observing something about his father that matters, settling in her own throat.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとリアリズムの絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad read a realism picture book with me.
lines.style: Eager, clear enunciation. Pride in what they read together, not just what they did. Small pause before 'realism' — he's learning new words. Ends with warmth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがホビーショップで模型をお買いになったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought a model at the hobby shop.
lines.style: Soft, observant. Voice carries a small smile. Steady pace. Noticing the detail — not just that he shopped, but what he chose. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとマイカーで遠出したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me on a long car ride!
lines.style: Bright final note. Opening is quick and warm. Slight breathlessness — the trip was an adventure. Ends with genuine joy and closure, like he's been holding this in.
